services.name: Crunchbase
services.description: Filter companies by industry, geography and funding. Filter official Crunchbase companies, people and funding rounds by industry, geography, date, funding amount or stage. Use cb_reference for valid fields, operators and collection IDs. Resolve location/category names to returned identifiers before filtering. Money is integer USD and dates are ISO dates. Preserve all user filters; never silently drop a filter. Simple public-field predicates only; private CRM/saved-list and recursive relationship filters are unsupported. One page of at most 15 results.

services.name: Crunchbase
services.description: Fetch official company, leadership and funding data. Fetch an identified official Crunchbase company, person or funding-round profile. Retain all returned public fields and supported relationship cards: description, headquarters, website, headcount, founders, employees, board members, funding rounds, amounts and investors when the account provides them. Missing fields are unavailable, never inferred. Public Crunchbase page content may supplement the same result internally. No extra source or page charge. No automatic pagination.
